records.name: Audacious Laugh
records.effect: Non-damaging taunt that causes the locked-on opponent to become slightly staggered and receive a movement-speed slowdown.
records.notes: 2026-09-24 evidence refresh: current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation explicitly lists Audacious Laugh as an Other Super with a 100 Ki requirement, non-damaging/slow characteristics, and Zarbon's Instructor Quest 1 acquisition. Independent Dragon Ball Wiki documentation confirms the Future Warrior learns it by completing Zarbon's initiation test. No DLC requirement or Ultimate Finish condition is indicated by the mentor reward structure; these existing null/false values are retained.
